public_rationale: The reported Tokyo decline was 14.48%, which rounds to 14.5%. The company filing also documents substantial OpenAI investment. Neither establishes SoftBank's comparative position among generative-AI funders or the implied comparison with Nvidia. Because the supplied claim includes that funding description, the whole claim remains unresolved even though the price component is consistent with the evidence.
limitations: The monetary comparison has an unspecified basis and cannot receive a supported or contradicted verdict.
The price report labels SoftBank with a US ticker while explicitly describing yen-denominated Tokyo trading.
The filing is not subject to interim review procedures, according to its own notice.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: SoftBank, one of the biggest funders of generative AI after Nvidia, fell 14.5% overnight.

statement.excerpt: SoftBank, which after Nvidia was one of the biggest funders of generative AI, fell 14.5% overnight
statement.document_title: Breaking: Anthropic stock is crashing, and AI stocks have lost over 50% in 5 months.

from_speaker: one of the biggest funders of generative AI
our_interpretation: SoftBank means SoftBank Group's Tokyo-listed shares, rather than its telecommunications subsidiary or a US depositary receipt.
Overnight refers to the November 20 Tokyo session relative to the November 19 close, viewed from the US.
The percentage is rounded to one decimal place; an earlier intraday decline is not necessarily inconsistent with the final session decline.

The funding clause describes SoftBank as a leading generative-AI capital provider, with Nvidia singled out ahead of it. It does not specify an exact ordinal rank, investment universe or measurement basis.
The whole claim requires checking both the share-price movement and the funding comparison.
The contract's monetary scope records the funding comparison. The stock-price evidence is separate context and cannot settle that comparison.
criteria.support_condition: Trading records show a November 20 decline rounding to 14.5%, and comparable funding evidence establishes the claimed leading position relative to Nvidia and other major generative-AI funders.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable trading records show a materially incompatible session decline, or comparable funding evidence clearly disproves the stated relative funding position.
